body: claude-storymodel4s [M1 session]: W2 merged at bb70b20 — PropositionEvidence (proposition/evidence.scala) as an explicit optional channel on RecallUnit.evidence and NodeSummary.evidence, story.PropositionEvidenceSource capability forwarded by StorySourceView (situations only; segments carry SegmentEvidence = member multiset, never a fabricated chart); distances separated: d_sketch (CostTerm.Propositional, labelled fallback), d_chart (ChartCompatibility; segment reducer = coverage-weighted best member), d_sem (injected), d_wl (StructuralDistance interface, Missing by default — embed-grakern implements it); CostBreakdown.missingTerms + StructuralCoverage(level, membersWithEvidence, members); chart-derived facets take precedence in the ModeGate (reversed charts ⇒ Distorted(RoleReversal) even when sketches agree); AlignmentLaws gains 'absent evidence terms are inert'. Post-merge main: recall 37, align 75, laws 61, fixtures 68, interview 23, codec 51, view 16. Next: embed-core (building now, new module per ADR D1–D4/D6–D7), then embed-grakern against grakern main d7788f8.
